arrow_mind.description: You do not provoke attacks of opportunity for firing a bow in threatened squares. You can make attacks of opportunity with your bow.

snipers_eye.description: Allows you to make sneak attacks and death attacks at a range of up to 60 feet. Also grants darkvision and the ability to see through cover.

blindsight.description: Subject gains blindsight out to 30 feet, allowing them to pinpoint creatures without vision.
